key.description: Fixed number of workspaces managed by Heretic Tiling. Changes take effect after reloading the extension (disable + enable).

key.name: custom-workspace-indicator
key.summary: Use custom workspace indicator
key.description: When enabled, replaces the default GNOME Shell workspace dots with a custom numbered-button indicator in the left panel. Changes take effect after reloading the extension (disable + enable).

key.name: workspace-scroll-switch
key.summary: Switch workspace by scrolling the indicator
key.description: When enabled, scrolling the mouse wheel over the custom workspace indicator switches to the previous (scroll up) or next (scroll down) workspace.

key.name: highlight-empty-workspaces
key.summary: Highlight empty workspaces
key.description: When enabled, workspace buttons that contain no windows are rendered dimmer than workspaces that have windows.

key.name: middle-click-move
key.summary: Middle-click to move focused window
key.description: When enabled, middle-clicking a workspace button in the custom workspace indicator moves the currently focused window to that workspace and switches to it.

key.name: dim-unfocused-windows
key.summary: Dim unfocused windows
key.description: Darken inactive application windows. Applies immediately and is suspended in overview.

key.name: unfocused-window-dim-percent
key.summary: Inactive window brightness reduction (%)

key.name: center-cursor-on-focus
key.summary: Center cursor on focused window
key.description: Move the cursor to the center of the newly focused window whenever window focus changes. Changes take effect immediately.

key.name: focus-next-on-close
key.summary: Focus front-placed window when the active window is closed
key.description: When enabled, closing the focused window moves focus to the remaining window that is topmost in the stacking order on the same workspace, instead of Mutter's default focus behaviour.
